newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower in light trade.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower, and the December/March inverted spread widened slightly amid sluggish dealings, traders said.
Traders reported having seen some light producer-related selling in the March contract. New contract lows were set in December 1996, March, July and December 1997.
Losses may have been limited by news that Pakistan bought 270,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, traders said. A technical correction in CBOT wheat added spillover support, they said.

MGE spring wheat closed 1/4 to 3-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 3/4 cents at $3.84-1/2. The new Dec contract low was set at $3.83. The MGE Dec/March inverse widened to eight cents from seven cents late Friday.
U.S. wheat markets were pressured early after the Australian Wheat Board revised its forecast of Australian wheat output to 21 million tonnes, up from the previous estimate of 20 million tonnes.
Traders said LFG sold 1.2 million March and 500,000 Dec. Atwood/Peavey and CIS each sold 500,000 March.
MGE barley futures closed five to 10 cents per cwt lower, with Dec down 10 cents at $6.40.
